Here’s a closer look at Hipel Pools, JJ Pool Service, and Backyard Resorts and what makes them the best options for your pool’s grand debut.

We might be biased 😜but we think here at Hipel Pools we deliver exceptional pool opening services in the Kitchener-Waterloo. Known for their professionalism and attention to detail, this company consistently earns high praise from both long-time and new pool owners.

Pool Opening Service Offered

Hipel Pools offers a comprehensive pool opening service, that can be modified to meet your specific needs.

The standard pool opening package at Hipel pools includes:

  • Removing Cover, Fold & Place In Customer Provided Storage Bag
  • Lower Pool Water Level If Required
  • Remove Winterizing Plugs From Returns & Skimmers
  • Re-Install return eyeballs, & drain covers if required
  • Prime & Start Up Pool Equipment
  • Provide an Initial Chlorine Shock Treatment & Ph Balance

Why Customers Love Hipel Pools Openings

  • Reliable and punctual team.
  • Excellent communication, from simple online booking to automated follow-ups.

2. JJ Pool Service: Expert  Pool Service Solutions

Pool Opening Service Provided

  • Remove all winterizing plugs
  • Re-install jets, lights
  • Put in all drain plugs for pump, filter and accessories
  • Re-install ladders, diving board and deck equipment
  • Scrub coping and waterline
  • Prime circulation system and start pool when possible

Why Customers Appreciate JJ Pool Service

  • Quality weekly service packages.
  • Technicians with extensive knowledge of pool systems.
  • Flexible scheduling to accommodate customer needs.
